description: This file defines a mock class 'MediaKeySessionMock' implementing the 'IMediaKeySession' interface for testing purposes. It includes mock methods for media key session operations such as generateRequest, loadSession, updateSession, decrypt, closeKeySession, removeKeySession, getCdmKeySessionId, containsKey, setDrmHeader, getLastDrmError, selectKeyId, and isPlayreadyKeySystem.

classes.name: MediaKeySessionMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IMediaKeySession interface for unit testing, using Google Mock to simulate media key session behaviors.

methods.name: generateRequest
methods.description: Mocks the generation of a license request with specified init data type and data.

methods.name: loadSession
methods.description: Mocks loading a media key session.

methods.name: updateSession
methods.description: Mocks updating a session with response data.

methods.name: decrypt
methods.description: Mocks decrypting media data with specified buffers.

methods.name: getCdmKeySessionId
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the CDM key session ID.

methods.name: containsKey
methods.description: Mocks checking if a key ID is contained within the session.

methods.name: getLastDrmError
methods.description: Mocks retrieving the last DRM error code.

methods.name: selectKeyId
methods.description: Mocks selecting a key ID for the session.

methods.name: isPlayreadyKeySystem
methods.description: Mocks checking if the key system is PlayReady.
